description: This course introduces object-oriented programming concepts using Java. Students learn Java syntax, classes, inheritance, polymorphism, exception handling, multithreading, collections, file handling, GUI programming and database connectivity to develop robust object-oriented applications.

syllabus.title: Introduction to Java
syllabus.body: Overview of Java, Java Virtual Machine (JVM), Java Runtime Environment (JRE), Java Development Kit (JDK), Java program structure, data types, variables, operators, control statements, arrays, strings, methods, command line arguments and packages.

syllabus.title: Object-Oriented Programming Concepts
syllabus.body: Classes and objects, constructors, access modifiers, encapsulation, inheritance, method overriding, polymorphism, abstract classes, interfaces, packages, wrapper classes and inner classes.

syllabus.title: Exception Handling and Multithreading
syllabus.body: Exception hierarchy, try-catch-finally blocks, throw and throws keywords, user-defined exceptions, multithreading, thread life cycle, synchronization, thread priorities and inter-thread communication.

syllabus.title: Collections, File Handling and GUI
syllabus.body: Java Collection Framework, List, Set, Map, iterators, generics, file handling using streams, serialization, AWT, Swing components, event handling and layout managers.

syllabus.title: Database Connectivity
syllabus.body: JDBC architecture, database connectivity, drivers, connection establishment, SQL statements, prepared statements, result sets, transaction management and development of database applications using Java.

syllabus.title: Practical Exercises
syllabus.body: Programs on Java syntax, classes, inheritance, interfaces, exception handling, multithreading, collections, file handling, GUI applications using Swing and database connectivity using JDBC.

outcomes: Develop Java programs using object-oriented programming principles.
Implement inheritance, polymorphism, interfaces and exception handling in Java applications.
Develop concurrent applications using multithreading and synchronization.
Use Java Collection Framework, file handling and GUI programming to build desktop applications.
Develop database-driven applications using JDBC and Java.
